title: Getting started
summary: Get your game ready for Realm of Thrones Coop.

sections.heading: What you need
steps: Bannerlord 1.4.8 on Steam for Windows, with the War Sails DLC.
Realm of Thrones 8.1.2 from Nexus Mods in the game's Modules folder. The tools never contain it.
Harmony, ButterLib and UIExtenderEx from the Steam Workshop, and MCM from Nexus Mods.
Realm of Thrones Coop Compat and the Realm of Thrones build of Coop come with the launcher.
sections.tip: Official Coop 0.1.8 for Bannerlord 1.5.7 is currently available only on GitHub. The RoT tools include the Coop build for Bannerlord 1.4.8.

sections.heading: Before you join
steps: Ask the host for their mod list. On the Mods page, click Import mod list and pick that file.
On Play, click Check mods. Connect gets Harmony, ButterLib and UIExtenderEx from the Steam Workshop when one is missing.
MCM and the Realm of Thrones core are not downloaded for you. Get them from Nexus Mods.

sections.heading: Your own Coop
steps: Connect puts the launcher's Realm of Thrones build of Coop into the game's Modules folder as Modules\Coop.
If you had another Coop there, it asks first, sets it aside in the game folder and puts it back when you close the launcher.
Do not put your own Coop in Modules\Coop by hand while you use the launcher.
